options.content:
### HyperShift User Journey SLO Dashboard

Monitors whether **HyperShift creates and maintains a usable hosted control plane**, covering the HyperShift Operator (`hypershift` namespace) and the Control Plane Operator (CPO, in each `ocm-*` namespace).

**Proposed SLO Targets (pending baseline and stakeholder review):**
- Journey availability: >=99.95% of eligible HostedCluster samples with the hosted API available, 30d
- Journey errors: >=99.9% healthy HostedCluster samples (no HyperShift failure conditions), 30d
- Journey latency: >=99% of cluster creations reach initial availability within 30m, 30d
- Component availability: >=99.95% available/desired operator replicas, 30d
- Component errors: >=99.9% successful reconciliations, 30d
- Component latency: >=99% of reconciliations within 10s
- Component saturation: >=99% of intervals within limits
- Traffic and journey saturation are **informational** until baselined from historical data

**Eligibility:** availability samples exclude HostedClusters in their first 15m and clusters no longer reporting (same pattern as KASAvailable).

**Metrics Source:** `hypershift_*` metrics from the HyperShift Operator and CPO (openshift/hypershift), `controller_runtime_*`, `workqueue_*`, kube-state-metrics deployment metrics, container resource metrics. `hostedClusterAPI_kubeapiserver_available` (KASAvailable) is shown as supporting context.

**Jira:** [ARO-27787](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ARO-27787)

panels.title: Journey SLIs — HyperShift creates and maintains a usable hosted control plane

panels.description: Journey availability: eligible samples where the CPO /healthz probe of the hosted API succeeded / all eligible samples (excludes first 15m and clusters no longer reporting). Proposed SLO: 99.95% over 30d.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(sum_over_time((max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available offset 15m))[30d:5m]) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available)) / sum(count_over_time((max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available offset 15m))[30d:5m]) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available))

panels.title: Availability (30d)

panels.description: Journey errors: 1 - HostedClusters with a failure condition / HostedClusters, averaged over 30d. A cluster with several failure conditions is counted once per condition, so this is a conservative (pessimistic) estimate. Proposed SLO: 99.9%.
panels.title: Healthy Cluster Samples (30d)

panels.description: Journey latency: HostedClusters seen waiting for initial availability in the last 30d whose wait never exceeded 30m / all such HostedClusters. Clusters still waiting count as good until they pass 30m. Proposed SLO: 99%.
panels.title: Creations Available Within 30m (30d)

panels.description: Journey traffic (informational): current number of HostedClusters and NodePools.
panels.title: HostedClusters / NodePools

panels.description: Fraction of eligible HostedClusters whose CPO /healthz probe succeeds.

targets.expr: 100 * avg((max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available offset 15m)) and on (namespace) max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available))

panels.title: Availability Over Time (SLO 99.95%)

panels.description: 1 - HostedClusters with a failure condition / HostedClusters (conservative).
panels.title: Healthy HostedClusters Over Time (SLO 99.9%)

panels.description: Journey latency: seconds each HostedCluster has been waiting for initial availability. The metric only exists until the cluster first becomes available. SLO threshold: 30m (1800s).
panels.title: Initial Availability Wait by HostedCluster

panels.description: Journey traffic (informational): HostedClusters and NodePools, and conditions becoming true per hour (hypershift_hosted_cluster_transition_seconds_count by condition).
panels.title: Lifecycle Transitions and Object Counts (Traffic)

panels.description: Journey saturation (informational): HostedClusters still waiting for initial availability longer than 30m.
panels.title: Clusters Waiting > 30m

panels.description: Journey saturation (informational): HostedClusters currently waiting for initial availability.
panels.title: Transitioning HostedClusters

panels.description: Journey saturation (informational): transitioning HostedClusters over 30m / all transitioning HostedClusters.
panels.title: Share of Transitioning HostedClusters Over Limit
Component SLIs — HyperShift Operator and Control Plane Operator

panels.description: Component availability: available / desired operator replicas. Proposed SLO: 99.95% over 30d.

targets.expr: 100 * avg(avg_over_time((max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="hypershift", deployment="operator"}) / max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="hypershift", deployment="operator"}))[30d:5m]))

panels.title: Availability (30d)

panels.description: Component errors: successful reconciliations / all completed reconciliations. Proposed SLO: 99.9% over 30d.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*", result="error"}[30d]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*"}[30d]))))

100 * (1 - sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*", result="error"}[30d]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*"}[30d]))))

panels.title: Successful Reconciliations (30d)

panels.description: Component latency: reconciliations completing within 10s / all completed reconciliations. Proposed SLO: 99%.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*", le="10"}[30d]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_count{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*"}[30d])))

100 * sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*", le="10"}[30d]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_count{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*"}[30d])))

panels.title: Reconciliations Within 10s (30d)

panels.description: Component traffic (informational): reconciliations processed per second.
panels.title: Reconciliation Rate (1h)

panels.description: Component availability by operator (CPO shows the worst HCP).

targets.expr: min(max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="hypershift", deployment="operator"}) / max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="hypershift", deployment="operator"}))

min(max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace=~"ocm-.*", deployment="control-plane-operator"}) / max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace=~"ocm-.*", deployment="control-plane-operator"}))

panels.title: Available / Desired Replicas

panels.description: Component errors: successful / completed reconciliations.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*", result="error"}[5m]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*"}[5m]))))

100 * (1 - sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*", result="error"}[5m]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_total{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Reconciliation Success Rate (SLO 99.9%)

panels.description: Component latency: reconciliations completing within 10s.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*", le="10"}[5m]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_count{namespace="hypershift", pod=~"operator-.*"}[5m])))

100 * sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*", le="10"}[5m]))) / sum(max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_count{namespace=~"ocm-.*", pod=~"control-plane-operator-.*"}[5m])))

panels.description: Clusters where the CPO probe and the KSM condition disagree. The CPO metric is keyed by the control plane namespace (<HostedCluster namespace>-<name>), so KSM labels are joined into that form.

targets.expr: count(max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available) == 1 unless on (namespace) (label_join(max without(prometheus_replica) (hostedClusterAPI_kubeapiserver_available{status="True"}), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "name") == 1)) or vector(0)

count((label_join(max without(prometheus_replica) (hostedClusterAPI_kubeapiserver_available{status="True"}), "namespace", "-", "namespace", "name") == 1) unless on (namespace) (max without(prometheus_replica) (hypershift_kube_apiserver_available) == 1)) or vector(0)

options.content:
### Gaps and Open Questions

**Verified from the openshift/hypershift source and this repository:**
- `hypershift_hostedclusters`, `hypershift_hostedclusters_failure_conditions` (labels `platform`, `condition`) and `hypershift_nodepools` are gauges of object counts. A cluster with several failure conditions is counted once per condition.
- `hypershift_cluster_waiting_initial_availability_duration_seconds` (labels `namespace`, `name`, `_id`) is a per-cluster gauge that disappears once the cluster first becomes available. The 30m SLI is therefore derived from the maximum wait seen per cluster over the window.
- `hypershift_hosted_cluster_transition_seconds` is a histogram whose buckets stop at 600s and which does not cover the `Available` condition, so it is used only for the traffic panel.
- `hypershift_kube_apiserver_available` is a CPO gauge (1 if the KAS `/healthz` probe returns 200) with no cluster labels; it is scoped by the control plane namespace. `hostedClusterAPI_kubeapiserver_available` is a kube-state-metrics StateSet of the HostedCluster `KubeAPIServerAvailable` condition (Deployment Available), keyed by the HostedCluster namespace and name. The probe also exposes a latency histogram.

**Collection path (verified from source and this repository):**
- The HyperShift Operator install always creates a ServiceMonitor (30s interval, no metric filtering) for the `operator` Deployment in the `hypershift` namespace. `--platform-monitoring=None` only skips the OpenShift platform monitoring RBAC, and `--metrics-set=SRE` does not filter operator metrics.
- The CPO creates a PodMonitor per HCP namespace with no metric filtering (`ControlPlaneOperatorRelabelConfigs` returns nil).
- The management cluster Prometheus selects all ServiceMonitors and PodMonitors in all namespaces (`serviceMonitorSelector: {}`, `podMonitorSelector: {}`), so both are collected.
- Deployment and container names used in queries: `operator` (hypershift namespace) and `control-plane-operator` (HCP namespace). The control plane namespace is `<HostedCluster namespace>-<HostedCluster name>`.
- `controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds` has a `le="10"` bucket.

**KASAvailable patterns:**
- Reused here: good/eligible sample ratio, 15m new-cluster exclusion, current-series presence check, fleet SLO distribution.
- Display only as context: KAS availability and its metric comparison.
- Still to evaluate after SLO agreement: sample-count guards (HyperShift gauges update at the Prometheus scrape interval, unlike KSM), multi-window burn-rate alerting.
- Targets are proposals and must be based on historical data and stakeholder agreement, not inherited from the KASAvailable 99.95%.
